company.name: QuestDB
company.shortDescription: QuestDB is an open-source SQL database designed to process time-series data, faster.
company.description: QuestDB is a high performance database for time-series data. QuestDB’s software architecture has been designed from the ground up to be as close to the hardware structure as possible - offering breakthrough performance. Through QuestDB, companies can harness the power of time series data by handling billions of time-stamped events without relying on powerful hardware.

productsAndServices.description: An open-source SQL database optimized for high-throughput ingestion and fast querying of time-series data using extended SQL features.
productsAndServices.name: QuestDB Open Source Time-Series Database

productsAndServices.description: A commercial edition of QuestDB offering advanced features for large-scale, secure, and highly available time-series data management with expert support.
productsAndServices.name: QuestDB Enterprise

productsAndServices.description: Extended SQL syntax and functions tailored for time-series data analysis, enabling efficient temporal queries and data aggregation.
productsAndServices.name: Time-Series SQL Extensions

productsAndServices.description: Support for open data formats like Apache Parquet and Arrow, and integration with various data clients and frameworks for interoperability.
productsAndServices.name: Open Format Support and Integration Ecosystem

productsAndServices.description: Capabilities for ingesting millions of rows per second with deduplication and out-of-order data handling, combined with millisecond query response times.
productsAndServices.name: High-Performance Data Ingestion and Querying
